title: Flimsy material
text: Flimsy material. I'm sorry that I did not research these curtains more. I bought these for my son's house and had them shipped there. When I was able to go and hang the curtains, I was disappointed to find that they were not well finished and the fabric was fairly flimsy. I thought I had purchased the same brand or at least the same material as a set that I have on my patio door, which is much sturdier and well made. I guess that's on me but these were not as nice as I had hoped or expected.
